findings.title: Direct API Calls Bypass Model Router in Emergency Alerts

evidence.observation: Direct invocations of call_gemini and call_mistral via environment API keys instead of routing through the model router

proposed_action.description: Route emergency alert LLM synthesis tasks through the model router infrastructure rather than invoking provider APIs directly.

findings.expected_benefit: Maintains central routing policies, unified logging, fallback handling, and telemetry across all LLM operations.
